case.pattern_description: This fraud pattern involves four online purchases totaling $1,880.16 executed on card C06881-K1 within 30 minutes, keeping each transaction just under a $500 authorization threshold. It affects cardholders through anomalous spending well above the card's median. The pattern was found by an analyst reviewing a monitoring alert for same-band bursts of three or more online purchases between $400 and $500 within 90 minutes.

case.summary: An alert was triggered on card C06881-K1 for four online purchases totaling $1,880.16 executed within 30 minutes, with individual amounts kept just under a $500 threshold. The transaction amount of $464.58 significantly exceeded the card's median of $96.98, and product code C had no prior history on this card. Based on these indicators and historical case similarity, the verdict is confirmed fraud with an undocumented pattern and an exposure of $1,880.16. The automated system has created the case and escalated it to the analyst, while blocking the card and filing a report require human approval.

sar.narrative: Customer C06881, holder of card C06881-K1, is the subject of this report due to suspicious account activity. Between 2016-12-03 20:00 and 2016-12-03 20:30, four online transactions totaling $1,880.16 were executed on the card, including amounts of $462.13 (transaction 3510950 on 2016-12-03 20:00), $480.53 (transaction 3510982 on 2016-12-03 20:07), $464.58 (transaction 3511041 on 2016-12-03 20:24), and $472.92 (transaction 3511062 on 2016-12-03 20:30). These purchases occurred within 30 minutes of each other and were kept just under a $500 authorization threshold. The activity is suspicious because four online purchases were made rapidly with amounts between $400 and $500, and transaction 3511041 of $464.58 significantly exceeded the card's median of $96.98 and 95th percentile of $117.01. Furthermore, product code C had never been used on this card before, while the transactions utilized the device profile 'iOS Device | iOS 11.2.2 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2208x1242', which had one prior transaction on the card. This behavior closely mirrors eight closed cases confirmed as fraud, specifically including CC-1518, CC-1718, CC-1673, and CC-2330. In response to the identified exposure of $1,880.16 and the fraud verdict, the monitoring alert C06881-K1 was triggered, leading to automated actions including the creation of a case and escalation to an analyst. Final actions recommended include executing BLOCK_CARD (L1) and FILE_REPORT (L2), while the bank has retained all transaction, device, and investigation records for documentation.
